topic: The Rhythm of Mathematics: Understanding Music and Measure Theory
target_audience: Middle school students with an interest in music and basic arithmetic

sections.title: The Concept of Pulse: Beats as Units of Time
lecture_lines: Music is a journey through time.
The beat is our basic unit.
Like a clock, it ticks steady.
animations: Display steady pulse with glowing dots #FFD700 centered around.
Show beat timing increasing in brightness #FFFFFF as the hands sweep.
Visualize rhythmic gaps between pulses using gray #808080 relative to the face.

sections.title: Introduction to Measure (Bars)
lecture_lines: Four beats fit in one measure.
animations: Display vertical bar line #FFFFFF defining the measure.
Fill measure with rhythmic units #00FF7F in sync.
Close measure with second bar line #FFFFFF.

sections.title: The Math of Note Values (Fractions)
animations: Show whole note #FF6347 as full circle.
Split whole into two half notes #1E90FF.
Show four quarter notes #FFFF00 fitting one whole.

sections.title: Application: Composing with Constraints
animations: Place four quarter notes #00BFFF into measure.
Reset measure cycle #FF00FF for next loop.
